answer_verbatim:

- **CertPro Plumbing** — Located in Liberty and listed for backflow testing. **816-454-0247**
- **Taylor Plumbing** — Northland plumber offering certified backflow testing; based in Smithville. **816-532-0737** ([website](https://www.taylorplumbingservicesinc.com/))
